project_name: The Craft Centre - Portfolio CMS & Live Editor
archetype: ARCHETYPE 1: ORGANIC & EARTHY (Trust, Growth, Craft, Editorial Calm)
theme: Light, warm paper & bone tones with high contrast dark charcoal text

font_families.headings: Display Serif / Editorial Serif (e.g., Playfair Display or Garamond family)
font_families.body: Clean Humanist Sans (e.g., Work Sans / Inter for body legibility)
font_families.mono: JetBrains Mono / Source Code Pro for editor labels & metric controls

base.card_bg: #FFFFFF (Pure White for interactive contact card and focal containers)
base.text_primary: #1C1917 (Deep Obsidian / Dark Charcoal - never pure black)

visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle paper noise / organic grain overlay for tactile editorial depth
visual_enhancers.cards: 1px clean warm border, crisp rectangular edges, subtle ambient drop shadow (shadow-sm)
visual_enhancers.dividers: Clean subtle horizontal rules with controlled margin and opacity; remove jarring or stray section lines on Theatre page
visual_enhancers.selection_overlay: Interactive selection bounding box with 8-point resize handles and move grip without dark blanket background overlays

grids_and_layouts.marketing_editorial: Swiss Grid with asymmetric columns, split hero sections (50/50 or 60/40), high internal padding (p-8 to p-12)
grids_and_layouts.contact_layout: 2-column split with site info / address on left and customizable white contact card on right
grids_and_layouts.theatre_layout: Stacked editorial sections, media narrative blocks, split text/photo hero

explore_past_productions.action: Remove the 'Explore past production' link_label and button from TheatreArchive and TheatreProduction components where required, while preserving the parent photo asset.
explore_past_productions.implementation: Do not render TheatreLink when link_label is deleted or empty, and cleanly detach field selection from image selection so deleting text does not clear image state.

section_dividers.rule: Audit all .theatre-split-rule and section bottom border rules. Standardize clean border-b lines with opacity-20 warm stone color, eliminating redundant or misplaced border rules.

independent_movement.rule: Text nodes and Image nodes MUST have separate [data-edit] target attributes and independent CSS positioning (translateX, translateY) so dragging or moving text does NOT move the adjacent image or whole section container.

editable_fields.address_and_phone: Wrap contact address, phone numbers, and operational hours in editable SiteText or data-edit tags so admins can directly inline edit them via LiveEditor or FieldInspector.

white_card_container.editable_properties: The white contact card form container must expose data-edit='_section' or data-edit='card_container' allowing live width, height, padding, margin, background color, and corner radius adjustments in the LiveEditor control panel.

context_aware_selection.element_vs_section: When an individual field (image, heading, eyebrow, address) is clicked, target field ONLY (el.dataset.edit). Do not fall through to '_section' unless the user clicks directly on empty section canvas.
context_aware_selection.deletion: Deleting or clearing field text must modify data[field] value without calling remove(sec.id) or deleting the section/image sibling.

controls_and_toolbars.shortcuts: Ctrl/Cmd+S for save, Ctrl/Cmd+Z for undo, Esc for deselect, Arrow keys for 1px/10px nudge

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. In TheatreSections.jsx: Conditionally hide TheatreLink or remove 'Explore past production' text and button while ensuring the Photo component remains rendered and intact.
2. Separate data-edit bindings for image vs text fields so element movement (translateX, translateY) is isolated to the selected element.
3. Fix bottom section border lines across Theatre page sections to eliminate unwanted duplicate or misaligned lines.

4. In ContactForm.jsx / PageSections.jsx: Enable SiteText/data-edit for contact info (address, phone) and attach data-edit styling controls to the white card container for adjustable width/height/padding.
5. Ensure LiveEditor click handler precisely targets selected field rather than bubbling to whole section when text is empty or clicked.
6. Ensure all interactive and key informational elements have clear data-testid attributes.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts or uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) for floating bars.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g. transition: all). Exclude transforms from universal transitions.
You MUST NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center }).
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters (🤖, 🧠, 💡) for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
All interactive elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

accessibility.contrast_ratio: Minimum 4.5:1 for normal body text, 3:1 for large headers against bone background.
